title: LIGHT SEATED INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY PULSE. CHAIR WORK. EASY RHYTHM.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Thursday is light seated intervals — a soft pulse in the chair, nothing fierce. About ten minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft pulse done, and you showed up. Enjoy your Thursday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Lift one knee a little toward the ceiling, then set it down gently. Alternate sides with an easy rhythm. Soft hands on the seat edges if you like. Smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts. Two sets of eight each leg. Soft belly, lift one knee a little, set it down gently. Easy rhythm. Smaller lift is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the hips. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Start with hands near the shoulders, then press gently upward only as high as feels kind. Soft neck, easy breath. Smaller press is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, hands near the shoulders, press gently upward only as high as feels kind. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Reach the arms forward softly, then draw the elbows back as if squeezing a soft cushion between the shoulder blades. Soft neck, chest open. Smaller squeeze is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, reach forward softly, then draw the elbows back and open the chest. Soft neck. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the upper back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light hand on the backrest. Softly shift weight onto one foot and lift the other heel or foot a little. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch. Use the chair as much as you need. Soft tall posture, easy breath. Smaller hold is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two sets of about twenty seconds each side. Light hand on the chair, soft weight on one foot, lift the other a little. Use the chair as much as you need.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Shake it out. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session — lovely work.
